tests.name: gen_21
tests.intent: Trigger detection of indexable keys and emplace_new_key by parsing large objects with a custom object type that implements emplace_new_key and a standard hashable string type.

tests.name: gen_22

tests.name: gen_23
tests.intent: Test detect_indexable_keys with an object type that defines emplace_new_key but whose key type lacks a std::hash specialization to ensure SFINAE and detect_hash fallback work correctly without a hard compile error.

tests.name: gen_24
tests.intent: Exercise frame stack take method with local frame copies where heap is nullptr by parsing moderately nested arrays or objects triggering stack transitions.

tests.intent: Invoke sax_parse directly with json_sax_dom_parser on a custom indexable-key json type to explicitly reach indexed_keys detection and execution paths.
